BEFORE EVERY BEGINNING

श्री गणेशाय नमः

GANAPATI

The beginning of everything.

Before the first prayer.
Before the first step. There is Him.

SCROLL TO JOURNEY · SOUND RECOMMENDED

I · THE CREATION

Born of love.
Made divine.

In the stillness of Kailash, Parvati gave life to a child.
A son, shaped by her own power. A love without end.

“From the love of a mother, a beginning.”

II · THE GUARDIAN

A promise.
Unbroken.

“Guard this entrance. Let no one pass.”
He knew only his mother's word.
And he would stand by it.

III · THE ARRIVAL

The mountain
held its breath.

Shiva returned to a door that would not open.
A father who did not know his son.
A son who did not know his father.

IV · THE CONFRONTATION

Even courage
can meet destiny.

The guardian would not yield. The heavens trembled.
In a terrible moment, Shiva struck the child down.

Then, silence.

V · SHAKTI

A mother's grief.
A universe shaken.

Parvati's sorrow became a force the gods could not contain.
She asked for one thing alone.

“Bring back my son.”

VI · THE SEARCH

From the forest,
a new beginning.

Shiva sent his followers in search of a head to restore the child.
Through the mist, an elephant appeared.
Life would take a different form.

VII · THE REBIRTH

Not an ending.
A becoming.

An elephant's head. A divine breath.
The child opened his eyes.
And the world received Ganesha.

Vighnaharta · The remover of obstacles

VIII · THE BLESSING

Every journey.
Begins with Him.

Blessed to be worshipped first, Ganesha became the guardian of beginnings.
We seek wisdom to see the way.
And courage to walk it.

IX · GANESH CHATURTHI

A million homes.
One welcome.

Hands shape the clay. Lamps awaken.
Through flowers, music, and devotion,
Bappa comes home.

गणपति बप्पा मोरया!

X · THE RETURN

He never
truly leaves.

The form returns to the water.
The blessing stays with us.

Until we welcome you again.

पुढच्या वर्षी लवकर या

गणपति बप्पा मोरया
